mutations.name: the settle wait is skipped entirely — the naive read this replaces

mutations.find:
return Math.abs(a.x - b.x) <= BOX_EPSILON
    && Math.abs(a.y - b.y) <= BOX_EPSILON
    && Math.abs(a.width - b.width) <= BOX_EPSILON
    && Math.abs(a.height - b.height) <= BOX_EPSILON;

the epsilon widens to 500px, so anything mid-flight counts as settled
